title: Integrated Load Forecasting and Anomaly-Gated Supervisory Replay for Building Energy Management — R2 reproducibility package
description: R2 source code and release metadata for building load forecasting, anomaly detection and prospective supervisory replay. The complete numerical archive (frozen inputs, trained states, predictions and verifiers) is distributed as the GitHub v2.0.0 release attachment, identified by SHA-256 f234843a999c9884a5903a666ce23a5c98489109496d382540f20e1272864888. A source snapshot alone omits this large data/model archive. Software is MIT; author data/documentation retain CC BY 4.0 where granted; BDG2 inputs and derivatives retain separate upstream Attribution-ShareAlike terms. Component licenses and preparation disclosures are preserved.
